item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 16 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 16 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lemery, Mabini, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Tingloy, Tuy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Iba, Palauig, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso), Batangas(Balete, Tanauan, Laurel, Lipa, Lobo, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Juan, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Taysan), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes, Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Tagaytay, Mendez, Indang) and Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc), Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Silang, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza), Quezon(San Antonio, Tiaong, Candelaria, Sariaya, Dolores), Laguna(Calamba, San Pablo, Alaminos, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, San Pedro, Binan), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose, Mayantoc, San Clemente), Pampanga(Mabalacat, Angeles, Guagua, Santa Rita, Bacolor, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, San Fernando, Minalin, Santo Tomas, Apalit, Mexico, San Simon) and Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Paombong, Malolos, Pulilan, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Obando, Meycauayan, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Bulakan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, Santa Ignacia), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang, San Luis, Santa Ana) and Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Pantabangan, San Jose, Rizal, Bongabon), Laguna(Rizal, Nagcarlan, Victoria, Pila, Liliw, Majayjay, Magdalena, Santa Cruz, Luisiana, Cavinti, Pagsanjan, Lumban, Kalayaan, Paete, Pakil, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pangil, Siniloan, Famy), Rizal(Jala-Jala, Tanay, Pililla) and Quezon(Real, Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Atimonan, San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, General Nakar, Infanta, Panukulan, Polillo, Burdeos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
